description: This source file defines the TypeManifestProviderAttribute class, an attribute used to specify a metadata provider for an assembly in the Orleans.Serialization.Configuration namespace. It includes validation of the provider type, ensuring it implements ITypeManifestProvider.

classes.name: TypeManifestProviderAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class used to specify a metadata provider type that implements ITypeManifestProvider for an assembly.

methods.name: TypeManifestProviderAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the attribute with a provider type, validating that it is not null and implements ITypeManifestProvider.
